name: Controllability-Gated RND (CG-RND)
tagline: RND novelty multiplied by a learned soft controllability gate from inverse-dynamics confidence; floor β keeps high-novelty states rewarded.

key_hyperparams.name: β (gate floor)
key_hyperparams.role: minimum gate value to preserve RND signal

key_hyperparams.name: loss = RND + inverse_CE
key_hyperparams.role: joint training of inverse model with RND

init_recovers: Plain RND when β=1 or inverse model is uniform
diff_from_baseline: Vs RND: keeps the RND fixed-target / learned-predictor novelty as the primary signal but multiplies it by [β + (1-β)·p̂(a|s,s')] where p̂ is from a small inverse-dynamics network; trains a separate inverse encoder/head jointly. Vs ICM: doesn't use forward-model error as the bonus, only uses inverse-dyn for gating.

name: RND + Forward-Dynamics Bonus
tagline: Bonus = RND prediction error + 0.3·forward-dynamics MSE on a separate small encoder.

key_hyperparams.name: forward coefficient
key_hyperparams.role: weight on forward-dynamics novelty in bonus

diff_from_baseline: Vs RND/ICM: directly sums RND novelty and ICM-style forward-prediction error (with a small dim=128 separate forward encoder), with fixed mixing weights 1.0/0.3 in the bonus and 1.0/0.5 in the loss; no inverse-dynamics head, no gating.

name: BYOL-Explore (EMA Latent Distillation)
tagline: Replaces the RND fixed random target with an EMA-updated copy of the online encoder; bonus is the L2 between L2-normalized predictor and EMA target.
init_recovers: Becomes RND-like when τ=1 (target frozen at init copy)
diff_from_baseline: Vs RND: target encoder is no longer a fixed random net but an EMA copy of the trainable online encoder (BYOL-Explore style); both predictor output and target are L2-normalized before the squared difference, so the bonus is essentially 1-cosine; no inverse/forward dynamics, no controllability.

name: Reachability-Gated Hybrid Bonus
tagline: Geometric mean of RND and forward-dynamics errors, gated by sigmoid inverse-dynamics confidence; advantages mixed with adaptive scale balancing.
init_recovers: Approaches RND with full gate (=1) and forward error≈RND error
diff_from_baseline: Vs RND/ICM: defines bonus as the geometric-mean of RND novelty and forward-dynamics error (both clamped non-negative), then multiplies by a sigmoid-of-(inverse-dyn-prob - uniform) reachability gate; advantage mixing is also non-standard, rebalancing intrinsic/extrinsic by their |mean| and downweighting intrinsic when extrinsic is large.

name: Dual-Signal RND+Forward, Adaptive Mix
tagline: Sum of RND and forward-dynamics errors with weights w_RND, w_fwd computed from EMA error magnitudes via a softmax-temperature-style normalization.

key_hyperparams.name: forward_base_weight
key_hyperparams.role: base mixing weight for forward dynamics

init_recovers: Equal-weight RND + ICM-fwd at temperature → ∞; pure RND when w_fwd=0
diff_from_baseline: Vs RND/ICM: bonus is a weighted sum of RND and forward-prediction errors with mixing weights computed at each step from EMA-scaled relative errors raised to a small temperature 0.1 (so weights track the larger error); after a 10-update warmup, before that uses fixed 1.0/0.5; loss is plain RND + 0.5·forward MSE without inverse-dynamics.
